rationale:
% Base rate for "there is SOME underlying pulmonary pathology" given
% the surface presentation of a referable pulmonary symptom complex.
% Once such a case reaches adjudication (i.e., past the inclusion gate
% of being a workup-worthy presentation), the probability that there
% is a real underlying pathology is high — most referrals are not
% spurious.  Prior set just above 0.5 to remain non-committal across
% subtypes.
clause:
prior 0.60 for diagnosis(underlying_pulmonary_pathology)
  source "Wahbah M, et al. Changing trends in the distribution of the histologic types of lung cancer: a review of 4,439 cases. Ann Diagn Pathol. 2007; and ACCP evidence-based clinical practice guidelines, Chest 2007;132(3 Suppl):20S-22S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Base rate for pulmonary malignancy among adults presenting with an
% incidentally or symptomatically discovered lung mass.  Across the
% pulmonary-nodule/mass evaluation literature, the malignancy rate of
% a non-trivial lung mass in adults is meaningfully high; we anchor
% to a modest prior reflecting the broader population (including
% younger adults where the base rate is lower) prior to applying any
% observation-specific evidence.
clause:
prior 0.15 for diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Gould MK, et al. Evaluation of patients with pulmonary nodules: When is it lung cancer? ACCP Evidence-Based Clinical Practice Guidelines (2nd ed.). Chest. 2007;132(3 Suppl):108S-130S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Base rate for pulmonary actinomycosis is low at the population
% level; it is a rare disease (<1 per 100,000 per year) and even
% within the workup of suspicious lung masses, biopsy-proven
% actinomycosis is uncommon.
clause:
prior 0.03 for diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Mabeza GF, Macfarlane J. Pulmonary actinomycosis. Eur Respir J. 2003;21(3):545-551."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Base rate for pulmonary tuberculosis among adults presenting with
% a workup-worthy pulmonary process in a non-endemic high-income
% setting; deliberately low but non-zero given TB remains a global
% mimic of malignancy.
clause:
prior 0.05 for diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "World Health Organization. Global Tuberculosis Report 2023; CDC. Reported Tuberculosis in the United States, 2022."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Base rate for an underlying primary myeloid hematologic malignancy
% (CML / CMML / accelerated MPN) among adults presenting with
% prominent leukocytosis — low pre-test because most leukocytoses
% are reactive.
clause:
prior 0.05 for diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Granger JM, Kontoyiannis DP. Etiology and outcome of extreme leukocytosis in 758 nonhematologic cancer patients: a retrospective, single-institution study. Cancer. 2009;115(17):3919-3923."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Base rate for the action "proceed to tissue biopsy or advanced
% workup" once a patient is in workup at all.  The very fact that
% the question is asked suggests prior elevated; set above neutral.
clause:
prior 0.55 for next_diagnostic_step(biopsy_or_advanced_workup)
  source "Rivera MP, et al. Establishing the diagnosis of lung cancer: Diagnosis and management of lung cancer, 3rd ed: ACCP evidence-based clinical practice guidelines. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e142S-e165S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Young-adult age substantially lowers the prior for primary lung
% cancer (whose incidence is heavily age-skewed beyond 55) but
% raises the relative weight of hematologic neoplasm and infectious
% mimics on the differential.
clause:
contributes 0.30 from age(young_adult) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Siegel RL, Miller KD, Jemal A. Cancer statistics, 2023. CA Cancer J Clin. 2023;73(1):17-48."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Young-adult age modestly raises hematologic-malignancy posterior
% because while CML peak incidence is ~60, ~10% of cases occur
% under 30 and CMML can present in young adults — a non-trivially
% larger share of leukocytosis-with-monocytosis cases than in
% solid-tumor paraneoplastic series.
clause:
contributes 1.8 from age(young_adult) to diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Jabbour E, Kantarjian H. Chronic myeloid leukemia: 2022 update on diagnosis, therapy, and monitoring. Am J Hematol. 2022;97(9):1236-1256."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% African-American ancestry is associated with elevated incidence
% of lung cancer in never-smokers (RR ~1.5 for AA women vs.
% European-American women); this raises the malignancy posterior
% modestly when integrated with other features.
clause:
contributes 1.5 from race_ethnicity(african_american) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Thun MJ, et al. Lung cancer occurrence in never-smokers: an analysis of 13 cohorts and 22 cancer registry studies. PLoS Med. 2008;5(9):e185."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Female sex in never-smoker lung cancer is enriched (adenocarcinoma
% with EGFR / ALK alterations) — modest upward contribution.
clause:
contributes 1.3 from sex(female) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Sun S, Schiller JH, Gazdar AF. Lung cancer in never smokers — a different disease. Nat Rev Cancer. 2007;7(10):778-790."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Prior asthma is a known weak risk factor for lung cancer
% (meta-analytic OR ~1.2-1.4) — small upward contribution.
clause:
contributes 1.2 from past_medical_history(asthma) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Rosenberger A, et al. Asthma and lung cancer risk: a systematic investigation by the International Lung Cancer Consortium. Carcinogenesis. 2012;33(3):587-597."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Absence of tobacco/alcohol/IV-drug history meaningfully lowers
% the lung-cancer posterior (smoking is the dominant attributable
% risk factor; never-smoker status drops the population odds by
% ~10-20x, but partial information from a single history line
% warrants a more modest LR).
clause:
contributes 0.40 from substance_use_history(none) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Alberg AJ, et al. Epidemiology of lung cancer: Diagnosis and management of lung cancer, 3rd ed: ACCP evidence-based clinical practice guidelines. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e1S-e29S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Productive cough is non-specific — present in malignancy,
% infection, and many benign processes.  Small upward contribution
% to the broad "some pathology" query; otherwise neutral.
clause:
contributes 1.2 from symptom(productive_cough) to diagnosis(underlying_pulmonary_pathology)
  source "Irwin RS, et al. Diagnosis and management of cough: ACCP evidence-based clinical practice guidelines. Chest. 2006;129(1 Suppl):1S-23S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Hemoptysis substantially raises suspicion for both malignancy and
% TB / chronic infection.  In adult smokers and non-smokers alike
% it is a red-flag symptom; meta-analyses give an LR ~2.4-6 for
% lung cancer depending on cohort.  Use a moderate consensus value.
clause:
contributes 3.0 from symptom(hemoptysis) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Hopstaken RM, et al. Clinical prediction rules for adult patients with hemoptysis. Br J Gen Pract. 2007."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Hemoptysis is also a classic TB symptom (cavitary disease,
% Rasmussen aneurysm); raise TB posterior.
clause:
contributes 2.5 from symptom(hemoptysis) to diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "World Health Organization. Treatment of tuberculosis: guidelines, 4th ed. 2010; Bomanji JB, et al. Imaging in tuberculosis. Cold Spring Harb Perspect Med. 2015;5(6)."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Hemoptysis is also reported in ~30-50% of pulmonary actinomycosis
% case series — supports invasive disease.
clause:
contributes 2.0 from symptom(hemoptysis) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Kim TS, et al. Pulmonary actinomycosis: CT features in 16 patients. Eur Radiol. 2006;16(7):1543-1549."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Dyspnea is non-specific but supports a structurally significant
% pulmonary process (mass, effusion, consolidation).
clause:
contributes 1.3 from symptom(dyspnea) to diagnosis(underlying_pulmonary_pathology)
  source "Parshall MB, et al. An official American Thoracic Society statement: update on the mechanisms, assessment, and management of dyspnea. Am J Respir Crit Care Med. 2012;185(4):435-452."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% New-onset facial swelling, in the context of a mediastinal process,
% is a hallmark feature of superior vena cava (SVC) syndrome.
% Malignant SVC obstruction accounts for ~75-80% of SVC syndrome
% cases; the presence of this finding substantially raises the
% malignancy posterior.
clause:
contributes 4.0 from symptom(facial_swelling_new_onset) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Wilson LD, Detterbeck FC, Yahalom J. Clinical practice. Superior vena cava syndrome with malignant causes. N Engl J Med. 2007;356(18):1862-1869."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Prevertebral soft-tissue swelling on neck CT supports a deep
% infectious or infiltrative process (deep neck space infection,
% retropharyngeal/parapharyngeal mass effect, descending mediastinal
% extension).  Modest upward contribution to broad pathology.
clause:
contributes 1.8 from imaging_neck_ct(prevertebral_soft_tissue_swelling) to diagnosis(underlying_pulmonary_pathology)
  source "Vural FS, Girdler NM. Deep neck space infections: diagnosis and management. Br J Hosp Med (Lond). 2009;70(6):340-345."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Prevertebral / paratracheal soft-tissue swelling can also reflect
% bulky mediastinal lymphadenopathy with extracapsular spread —
% modestly supports malignancy.
clause:
contributes 1.5 from imaging_neck_ct(prevertebral_soft_tissue_swelling) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Rivera MP, et al. Establishing the diagnosis of lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e142S-e165S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Persistent neck and facial swelling despite empirical outpatient
% antibiotics argues against a straightforward bacterial CAP or
% simple deep-neck-space infection and modestly raises malignancy
% and chronic-infection posteriors.
clause:
contributes 1.8 from symptom_course(persistent_neck_facial_swelling) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Detterbeck FC, et al. SVC syndrome with malignant causes. N Engl J Med. 2007;356(18):1862-1869."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Persistent swelling also keeps actinomycosis on the differential
% (actinomycosis is classically described as a chronic indolent
% process unresponsive to short courses of antibiotics).
clause:
contributes 1.5 from symptom_course(persistent_neck_facial_swelling) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Wong VK, et al. Actinomycosis. BMJ. 2011;343:d6099."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Tooth extraction without improvement: this is a negative test for
% the dental-source hypothesis.  Lowers the posterior that the
% process is an odontogenic / cervicofacial actinomycosis pivoting
% on an active dental source, but does not eliminate pulmonary
% actinomycosis (which can be primary).  Treat as small downward
% effect.
clause:
contributes 0.7 from intervention(tooth_extraction) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Wong VK, et al. Actinomycosis. BMJ. 2011;343:d6099."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% No improvement after a putatively appropriate intervention raises
% the posterior for non-infectious or chronic processes.
clause:
contributes 1.8 from response_to_intervention(no_improvement) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Rivera MP, et al. Establishing the diagnosis of lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e142S-e165S."
  trust authoritative

rationale: % No improvement also drives the next-step query toward biopsy.
clause:
contributes 2.5 from response_to_intervention(no_improvement) to next_diagnostic_step(biopsy_or_advanced_workup)
  source "Rivera MP, et al. Establishing the diagnosis of lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e142S-e165S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Continued facial swelling at three weeks is the same signal as
% the earlier persistent swelling — to avoid double-counting we
% keep the contribution modest.
clause:
contributes 1.3 from symptom(persistent_facial_swelling) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Wilson LD, Detterbeck FC, Yahalom J. SVC syndrome with malignant causes. N Engl J Med. 2007;356(18):1862-1869."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Worsening hemoptysis over weeks is a progressive red flag —
% incremental upward push on both malignancy and TB.
clause:
contributes 1.8 from symptom_progression(worsening_hemoptysis) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Hopstaken RM, et al. Clinical prediction rules for adult patients with hemoptysis. Br J Gen Pract. 2007."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Worsening hemoptysis is also a TB progression signal (cavitary
% expansion, Rasmussen aneurysm risk) — moderate upward push on TB.
clause:
contributes 1.5 from symptom_progression(worsening_hemoptysis) to diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "Bomanji JB, et al. Imaging in tuberculosis. Cold Spring Harb Perspect Med. 2015;5(6):a017814."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Night sweats are a classic B-symptom: raises posterior for TB,
% lymphoma, advanced solid malignancy, and chronic infection.
clause:
contributes 2.0 from symptom(night_sweats) to diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "Lewinsohn DM, et al. Official ATS/IDSA/CDC clinical practice guidelines: diagnosis of tuberculosis in adults and children. Clin Infect Dis. 2017;64(2):e1-e33."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Night sweats are also a recognized constitutional symptom of
% advanced malignancy (B-symptom analog) — moderate upward push.
clause:
contributes 1.5 from symptom(night_sweats) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Mold JW, et al. Night sweats: a systematic review of the literature. J Am Board Fam Med. 2012;25(6):878-893."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Night sweats are also a B-symptom of myeloid neoplasm (CML,
% accelerated MPN), independent of solid-tumor pathways.
clause:
contributes 1.5 from symptom(night_sweats) to diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Mold JW, et al. Night sweats: a systematic review of the literature. J Am Board Fam Med. 2012;25(6):878-893."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Absence of fever modestly lowers the posterior for acute
% pyogenic infection but does NOT meaningfully lower TB or
% malignancy posteriors (both commonly afebrile).  Use a small
% downward LR only on infection-broad terms; here we apply only
% to actinomycosis as the dominant infection-on-differential.
clause:
contributes 0.8 from denies(fever) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Mabeza GF, Macfarlane J. Pulmonary actinomycosis. Eur Respir J. 2003;21(3):545-551."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% No sick contacts — small downward push on community-acquired
% infectious etiology in general; routed to actinomycosis where
% transmission would be epidemiologically irrelevant anyway, so
% effect is small.
clause:
contributes 0.9 from denies(sick_contacts) to diagnosis(underlying_pulmonary_pathology)
  source "Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Principles of Epidemiology in Public Health Practice, 3rd ed. 2012."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% No recent travel slightly lowers travel-associated infections
% (endemic mycoses, certain TB exposures).  Modest downward push
% on TB.
clause:
contributes 0.7 from denies(recent_travel) to diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "Lewinsohn DM, et al. ATS/IDSA/CDC TB diagnosis guidelines. Clin Infect Dis. 2017;64(2):e1-e33."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% No known TB exposure further lowers TB posterior (key element
% of TB risk-stratification per CDC).
clause:
contributes 0.5 from denies(tuberculosis_exposure) to diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "Lewinsohn DM, et al. ATS/IDSA/CDC TB diagnosis guidelines. Clin Infect Dis. 2017;64(2):e1-e33."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% intent_not_encoded: self-attributed-intentional weight loss in a
% patient who is also losing weight from disease is a notoriously
% unreliable self-report; the literature treats it as a near-tie
% between (a) actual intentional loss and (b) involuntary loss
% rationalized by the patient.  Adj-Lang cannot easily encode "this
% observation should be discounted because of self-report bias" in
% a single term-grain clause.  We therefore apply a SMALL upward
% LR (rather than the larger LR that involuntary cancer-cachexia
% would warrant) reflecting the diagnostic ambiguity, and document
% the reduction here.
clause:
contributes 1.3 from symptom(weight_loss_self_attributed_intentional) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Nicholson BD, et al. The diagnosis of cancer in primary care after weight loss: a systematic review and individual patient data meta-analysis. Br J Gen Pract. 2018;68(670):e333-e338."
  trust empirical

rationale: % Same observation gives a modest TB upward push (TB cachexia).
clause:
contributes 1.3 from symptom(weight_loss_self_attributed_intentional) to diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "Lewinsohn DM, et al. ATS/IDSA/CDC TB diagnosis guidelines. Clin Infect Dis. 2017;64(2):e1-e33."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Dentist confirmed no active dental infection — meaningfully
% lowers the posterior for an odontogenic cervicofacial
% actinomycosis (Actinomyces is dental-flora-derived) but is only
% weakly informative against PRIMARY pulmonary actinomycosis (which
% can arise from aspiration of oral flora without active dental
% disease).  Use a modest downward LR.
clause:
contributes 0.6 from dental_infection(absent) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Wong VK, et al. Actinomycosis. BMJ. 2011;343:d6099; Russo TA. Agents of actinomycosis. In: Mandell, Douglas, and Bennett's Principles and Practice of Infectious Diseases, 9th ed. 2020."
  trust consensus

rationale:
% Markedly elevated WBC (extreme leukocytosis ≥40,000) in a young
% adult without obvious acute pyogenic source: large upward push
% on hematologic malignancy posterior (CML / CMML / accelerated
% MPN), and a meaningful but smaller push on paraneoplastic solid
% tumor (paraneoplastic leukemoid reaction reported in ~1-4% of
% solid tumors).
clause:
contributes 4.0 from white_blood_cell_count(markedly_elevated) to diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Granger JM, Kontoyiannis DP. Etiology and outcome of extreme leukocytosis in 758 nonhematologic cancer patients: a retrospective, single-institution study. Cancer. 2009;115(17):3919-3923; Jabbour E, Kantarjian H. Chronic myeloid leukemia: 2022 update. Am J Hematol. 2022;97(9):1236-1256."
  trust consensus

rationale:
% Extreme leukocytosis also raises solid-tumor malignancy posterior
% via paraneoplastic leukemoid reaction (reported in 1-4% of solid
% tumors, with lung cancer over-represented).
clause:
contributes 1.8 from white_blood_cell_count(markedly_elevated) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Granger JM, Kontoyiannis DP. Cancer. 2009;115(17):3919-3923; Chakraborty S, et al. Paraneoplastic leukemoid reaction in solid tumors. Am J Clin Oncol. 2015;38(3):326-330."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Extreme leukocytosis also strongly motivates expedited diagnostic
% workup (bone marrow biopsy, FISH for BCR-ABL).
clause:
contributes 2.5 from white_blood_cell_count(markedly_elevated) to next_diagnostic_step(biopsy_or_advanced_workup)
  source "NCCN Guidelines: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia, v3.2024; Arber DA, et al. International Consensus Classification of Myeloid Neoplasms and Acute Leukemias. Blood. 2022;140(11):1200-1228."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Neutrophilia alone is non-specific (any inflammatory state).
% Apply only a small upward contribution.
clause:
contributes 1.2 from differential(neutrophilia) to diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "George TI. Malignant or benign leukocytosis. Hematology Am Soc Hematol Educ Program. 2012;2012:475-484."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Left shift with circulating myelocyte precursors is a hallmark of
% a myeloproliferative process (and can occur in severe sepsis, but
% in an indolent multi-week course argues strongly for a clonal
% myeloid neoplasm).
clause:
contributes 3.5 from differential(left_shift_myelocyte_precursors) to diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Arber DA, et al. International Consensus Classification of Myeloid Neoplasms. Blood. 2022;140(11):1200-1228."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Left shift modestly raises the action posterior (drives bone-
% marrow / molecular workup).
clause:
contributes 2.0 from differential(left_shift_myelocyte_precursors) to next_diagnostic_step(biopsy_or_advanced_workup)
  source "NCCN Guidelines: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia, v3.2024."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Monocytosis in this context strongly raises CMML on the
% differential — CMML is defined in part by persistent monocytosis
% ≥1.0 × 10^9/L (WHO/ICC).
clause:
contributes 3.0 from differential(monocytosis) to diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Arber DA, et al. International Consensus Classification of Myeloid Neoplasms. Blood. 2022;140(11):1200-1228; Patnaik MM, Tefferi A. Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia: 2022 update. Am J Hematol. 2022;97(3):352-372."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Moderately low hemoglobin — anemia of chronic disease /
% inflammation / marrow infiltration.  Small upward on all three
% disease-class queries; routed to the broad envelope.
clause:
contributes 1.3 from hemoglobin(moderately_low) to diagnosis(underlying_pulmonary_pathology)
  source "Weiss G, Goodnough LT. Anemia of chronic disease. N Engl J Med. 2005;352(10):1011-1023."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Anemia + thrombocytosis pattern is suggestive of chronic
% inflammation / paraneoplastic / MPN — modest upward on
% malignancy and myeloid neoplasm.
clause:
contributes 1.4 from hemoglobin(moderately_low) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Weiss G, Goodnough LT. Anemia of chronic disease. N Engl J Med. 2005;352(10):1011-1023."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Elevated platelets (reactive thrombocytosis or MPN-related
% thrombocytosis).  Modest upward signal across malignancy and
% myeloid neoplasm.
clause:
contributes 1.4 from platelet_count(elevated) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Bailey SE, et al. Clinical relevance of thrombocytosis in primary care: a prospective cohort study. Br J Gen Pract. 2017;67(659):e405-e413."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Thrombocytosis is also a MPN-defining feature (essential
% thrombocythemia, CML chronic phase often has thrombocytosis);
% somewhat stronger upward push on myeloid neoplasm than on solid
% tumor.
clause:
contributes 1.6 from platelet_count(elevated) to diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Arber DA, et al. International Consensus Classification of Myeloid Neoplasms. Blood. 2022;140(11):1200-1228."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Negative urinalysis modestly lowers urinary-source infection /
% systemic illness from a renal driver — minor downward push on
% broad pathology query; effect is small.
clause:
contributes 0.95 from urinalysis(negative) to diagnosis(underlying_pulmonary_pathology)
  source "Schmiemann G, et al. The diagnosis of urinary tract infection: a systematic review. Dtsch Arztebl Int. 2010;107(21):361-367."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Right upper lobe mass: large upward push on lung malignancy
% (upper lobes are the most common location for both adenocarcinoma
% and squamous cell carcinoma), and a moderate upward push on TB
% (upper-lobe predominance is classic).
clause:
contributes 5.0 from imaging_chest_ct(right_upper_lobe_mass) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Quekel LG, et al. Detection of lung cancer on the chest radiograph: a retrospective study of the chest X-ray missed lung cancer. Chest. 1999;115(3):720-724; Gould MK, et al. ACCP guidelines on pulmonary nodules. Chest. 2007;132(3 Suppl):108S-130S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Upper-lobe predominance is the classical TB radiographic pattern
% (post-primary cavitary disease).  Moderate upward push on TB.
clause:
contributes 2.0 from imaging_chest_ct(right_upper_lobe_mass) to diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "Bomanji JB, et al. Imaging in tuberculosis. Cold Spring Harb Perspect Med. 2015;5(6):a017814."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Pulmonary actinomycosis can also present as an upper-lobe mass-
% like consolidation; modest upward push.
clause:
contributes 1.8 from imaging_chest_ct(right_upper_lobe_mass) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Kim TS, et al. Pulmonary actinomycosis: CT features in 16 patients. Eur Radiol. 2006;16(7):1543-1549."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Mediastinal involvement is a key staging finding strongly
% suggestive of advanced malignancy or invasive infection.
clause:
contributes 3.5 from imaging_chest_ct(mediastinal_involvement) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Silvestri GA, et al. Methods for staging non-small cell lung cancer: ACCP evidence-based clinical practice guidelines, 3rd ed. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e211S-e250S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Mediastinal extension is also a recognized (though less common)
% feature of invasive pulmonary actinomycosis from
% transfissural / chest-wall extension.  Moderate upward push.
clause:
contributes 2.0 from imaging_chest_ct(mediastinal_involvement) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Han JY, et al. Pulmonary actinomycosis with mediastinal involvement: a case report. Korean J Radiol. 2003;4(2):122-125."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Regional lymphadenopathy — staging concern for malignancy,
% also seen in TB and lymphoma.
clause:
contributes 2.5 from imaging_chest_ct(regional_lymphadenopathy) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Silvestri GA, et al. Methods for staging non-small cell lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e211S-e250S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Hilar/mediastinal lymphadenopathy is also a hallmark TB finding
% (especially in primary or post-primary disease).  Moderate
% upward push on TB.
clause:
contributes 2.0 from imaging_chest_ct(regional_lymphadenopathy) to diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "Bomanji JB, et al. Imaging in tuberculosis. Cold Spring Harb Perspect Med. 2015;5(6):a017814."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Right pleural effusion in setting of mass: malignant pleural
% effusion is a stage IV indicator; raise malignancy posterior.
clause:
contributes 2.5 from imaging_chest_ct(right_pleural_effusion) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Roberts ME, et al. BTS pleural disease guideline 2010: management of a malignant pleural effusion. Thorax. 2010;65(Suppl 2):ii32-ii40."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Pleural effusion is also reported in TB (tuberculous pleurisy)
% and actinomycosis.
clause:
contributes 1.5 from imaging_chest_ct(right_pleural_effusion) to diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "Light RW. Update on tuberculous pleural effusion. Respirology. 2010;15(3):451-458."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Pleural effusion is reported in roughly 20-30% of pulmonary
% actinomycosis case series.  Small upward push.
clause:
contributes 1.3 from imaging_chest_ct(right_pleural_effusion) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Kim TS, et al. Pulmonary actinomycosis: CT features in 16 patients. Eur Radiol. 2006;16(7):1543-1549."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Any of these imaging findings substantially drives next-step
% toward tissue biopsy; encode on the most informative single
% finding (mediastinal involvement) to avoid additive double-counting.
clause:
contributes 3.0 from imaging_chest_ct(mediastinal_involvement) to next_diagnostic_step(biopsy_or_advanced_workup)
  source "Rivera MP, et al. Establishing the diagnosis of lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e142S-e165S; Silvestri GA, et al. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e211S-e250S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Rising WBC despite broad-spectrum antibacterial therapy further
% suggests non-bacterial driver (myeloid neoplasm, paraneoplastic).
clause:
contributes 2.5 from white_blood_cell_count_trend(rising_markedly_elevated) to diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Granger JM, Kontoyiannis DP. Etiology and outcome of extreme leukocytosis. Cancer. 2009;115(17):3919-3923."
  trust empirical

contributes 1.5 from white_blood_cell_count_trend(rising_markedly_elevated) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Chakraborty S, et al. Paraneoplastic leukemoid reaction in solid tumors. Am J Clin Oncol. 2015;38(3):326-330."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Rising extreme leukocytosis is also a clinical trigger for
% urgent hematologic workup (peripheral smear, FISH for BCR-ABL,
% bone marrow biopsy) — moderate upward push on the action query.
clause:
contributes 2.0 from white_blood_cell_count_trend(rising_markedly_elevated) to next_diagnostic_step(biopsy_or_advanced_workup)
  source "NCCN Guidelines: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia, v3.2024."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Sputum culture growing Actinomyces is the central diagnostic
% pivot for q3.  However, Actinomyces is part of normal oral flora
% and contaminates expectorated sputum frequently; isolated growth
% from a non-bronchoscopically-obtained specimen is INSUFFICIENT
% for diagnosis.  We therefore apply a moderate upward LR (raises
% suspicion) but explicitly NOT a confirmatory LR.
clause:
contributes 4.0 from sputum_culture(actinomyces) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Russo TA. Agents of actinomycosis. In: Mandell, Douglas, and Bennett's Principles and Practice of Infectious Diseases, 9th ed. 2020; Wong VK, et al. Actinomycosis. BMJ. 2011;343:d6099."
  trust consensus

rationale:
% intent_not_encoded: The clinical reality is that an Actinomyces
% sputum growth WITHOUT histopathology + sulfur granules + invasive
% disease pattern should not collapse the differential to
% actinomycosis; in cancer-mimic series, Actinomyces is often a
% colonizer in an obstructed bronchus distal to a malignancy.
% Adj-Lang cannot express "this observation supports BOTH q2 (as
% post-obstructive colonization) AND q3 (as primary infection)
% with the relative weight depending on other findings" in a single
% clause.  We capture HALF of that by also raising the malignancy
% posterior — Actinomyces colonization can be a marker of
% bronchial obstruction by tumor.
clause:
contributes 1.5 from sputum_culture(actinomyces) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Choi J, et al. Pulmonary actinomycosis presenting with endobronchial obstruction: a clinical mimicker of lung cancer. Respir Med Case Rep. 2018;25:96-99; Mabeza GF, Macfarlane J. Pulmonary actinomycosis. Eur Respir J. 2003;21(3):545-551."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Failure of broad-spectrum inpatient antibiotics to improve the
% patient is a strong argument AGAINST a straightforward bacterial
% infection (including a sensitive actinomycosis, which usually
% responds at least partially to beta-lactams over days-to-weeks)
% and FOR malignancy or hematologic neoplasm.
clause:
contributes 2.5 from response_to_inpatient_antibiotics(no_improvement) to diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Rivera MP, et al. Establishing the diagnosis of lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e142S-e165S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Actinomyces is usually susceptible to penicillin-class agents
% (Augmentin, ceftriaxone, piperacillin-tazobactam) and a true
% invasive actinomycosis typically shows at least partial response
% within a week of appropriate therapy.  Failure to improve on
% these agents argues against actinomycosis being the primary
% pathology.
clause:
contributes 0.5 from response_to_inpatient_antibiotics(no_improvement) to diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Wong VK, et al. Actinomycosis. BMJ. 2011;343:d6099; Mabeza GF, Macfarlane J. Pulmonary actinomycosis. Eur Respir J. 2003;21(3):545-551."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Antibiotic failure also raises the myeloid neoplasm posterior:
% if the leukocytosis is clonal rather than reactive it will not
% resolve with source control / antibacterials.
clause:
contributes 1.5 from response_to_inpatient_antibiotics(no_improvement) to diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Jabbour E, Kantarjian H. Chronic myeloid leukemia: 2022 update. Am J Hematol. 2022;97(9):1236-1256."
  trust empirical

rationale:
% Failed empirical antibiotics is a guideline-recognized trigger
% to escalate to tissue diagnosis — strong upward push on action.
clause:
contributes 3.0 from response_to_inpatient_antibiotics(no_improvement) to next_diagnostic_step(biopsy_or_advanced_workup)
  source "Rivera MP, et al. Establishing the diagnosis of lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e142S-e165S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Triad of upper-lobe mass + mediastinal involvement + regional
% lymphadenopathy: gestalt above sum of parts for malignancy.
% Modest super-additive boost to malignancy posterior (the
% individual contributions already account for most of the
% effect; here we add a small joint kicker).
clause:
interacts 1.5 when imaging_chest_ct(right_upper_lobe_mass) and imaging_chest_ct(mediastinal_involvement) and imaging_chest_ct(regional_lymphadenopathy)
  for diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Silvestri GA, et al. Methods for staging non-small cell lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e211S-e250S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Extreme leukocytosis + monocytosis + left shift: this triad is
% nearly diagnostic of a chronic myeloid neoplasm (CML / CMML).
% Strong joint kicker on the myeloid posterior.
clause:
interacts 4.0 when white_blood_cell_count(markedly_elevated) and differential(monocytosis) and differential(left_shift_myelocyte_precursors)
  for diagnosis(hematologic_malignancy_myeloid)
  source "Arber DA, et al. International Consensus Classification of Myeloid Neoplasms. Blood. 2022;140(11):1200-1228; Patnaik MM, Tefferi A. CMML: 2022 update. Am J Hematol. 2022;97(3):352-372."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Lung mass + failure of antibacterial therapy: a strong gestalt
% argument for biopsy.
clause:
interacts 2.0 when imaging_chest_ct(right_upper_lobe_mass) and response_to_inpatient_antibiotics(no_improvement)
  for next_diagnostic_step(biopsy_or_advanced_workup)
  source "Rivera MP, et al. Establishing the diagnosis of lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e142S-e165S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Hemoptysis + upper-lobe mass + B-symptoms: classical triad that
% mandates tissue diagnosis above standard imaging.
clause:
interacts 2.0 when symptom(hemoptysis) and imaging_chest_ct(right_upper_lobe_mass) and symptom(night_sweats)
  for next_diagnostic_step(biopsy_or_advanced_workup)
  source "Rivera MP, et al. Establishing the diagnosis of lung cancer. Chest. 2013;143(5 Suppl):e142S-e165S."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Facial swelling + mediastinal involvement strongly argues SVC
% syndrome from a mediastinal mass — joint kicker on malignancy.
clause:
interacts 2.0 when symptom(facial_swelling_new_onset) and imaging_chest_ct(mediastinal_involvement)
  for diagnosis(pulmonary_malignancy)
  source "Wilson LD, Detterbeck FC, Yahalom J. SVC syndrome with malignant causes. N Engl J Med. 2007;356(18):1862-1869."
  trust authoritative

rationale:
% Actinomyces growth + dental infection absent + failure to respond
% to antibiotics: jointly argues that Actinomyces is a colonizer
% in this case rather than the primary driver — joint downward push
% on actinomycosis posterior.
clause:
interacts 0.4 when sputum_culture(actinomyces) and dental_infection(absent) and response_to_inpatient_antibiotics(no_improvement)
  for diagnosis(pulmonary_actinomycosis)
  source "Mabeza GF, Macfarlane J. Pulmonary actinomycosis. Eur Respir J. 2003;21(3):545-551; Russo TA. Mandell's Principles and Practice of Infectious Diseases, 9th ed. 2020."
  trust consensus

rationale:
% No-TB-exposure + no-travel + negative epidemiology: jointly
% lowers TB posterior more than either alone (these are not
% independent — they share a common epidemiologic cause).
clause:
interacts 0.5 when denies(tuberculosis_exposure) and denies(recent_travel)
  for diagnosis(pulmonary_tuberculosis)
  source "Lewinsohn DM, et al. ATS/IDSA/CDC TB diagnosis guidelines. Clin Infect Dis. 2017;64(2):e1-e33."
  trust authoritative
